limitations: One short cycle per engine does not establish long-duration stability or a statistical latency percentile.

Executed on macOS arm64 with a Linux arm64 Docker sandbox; not a Windows or Linux desktop installation test.

The qualification drives the service operations from a test, not from the desktop app.
